mapper.select:
SELECT p.id, p.name, p.image_url as imageUrl, p.sale_status as saleStatus, p.is_active as isActive, p.pre_name as preName, p.pre_is_active as preIsActive, p.created_at as createdAt, b.id as brandId, b.name as brandName, c.id as categoryId, c.name as categoryName, MIN(CASE WHEN p.pre_is_active = TRUE AND s.pre_price IS NOT NULL THEN s.pre_price ELSE s.selling_price END) as minPrice, MAX(CASE WHEN p.pre_is_active = TRUE AND s.pre_price IS NOT NULL THEN s.pre_price ELSE s.selling_price END) as maxPrice FROM product p LEFT JOIN sku s ON p.id = s.product_id AND s.deleted_at IS NULL AND s.is_active = TRUE LEFT JOIN brand b ON p.brand_id = b.id LEFT JOIN category c ON p.category_id = c.id
p.deleted_at IS NULL
AND LOWER(p.name) LIKE LOWER(CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND p.brand_id IN
#{id}
AND p.category_id IN
#{id}
AND p.sale_status IN
#{status}
AND ( p.created_at < #{lastCreatedAt} OR (p.created_at = #{lastCreatedAt} AND p.id < #{lastId}) )
AND ( p.created_at > #{lastCreatedAt} OR (p.created_at = #{lastCreatedAt} AND p.id > #{lastId}) )
GROUP BY p.id, b.id, c.id
HAVING 1=1
AND MIN(CASE WHEN p.pre_is_active = TRUE AND s.pre_price IS NOT NULL THEN s.pre_price ELSE s.selling_price END) >= #{minPriceFilter}
AND MAX(CASE WHEN p.pre_is_active = TRUE AND s.pre_price IS NOT NULL THEN s.pre_price ELSE s.selling_price END) <= #{maxPriceFilter}
ORDER BY
minPrice
p.name
p.created_at
ASC DESC
, p.id DESC
LIMIT #{limit}
